title: Widget grounds own build status and restores encrypted account-bound context without replay
steps: Run focused Node tests in run.cmd with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to an isolated test database. SQL/API/model fixtures never use user audio, customer sites or real model inference.
expect: Inspect requires session, editing grant, matching job/site and creator account before SELECT-only return; no host calls or handover writes.
Unknown persisted states are unavailable; completion links come from persisted server facts.
Signed-in model tools and actions cannot open sign-in; current-status tool accepts no arbitrary IDs.
Encrypted context binds visitor, account, revision, purpose and expiry; tampered metadata refuses, expired context rotates visitor and CAS conflicts never retry.
Locked same-account reauthentication hydrates history/build; another account sees no old context.
Turn inflight is durable before inference; final history is durable before response; a restart returns uncertain words for manual review without inference replay.
Real PostgreSQL scratch database applies migration126, verifies encrypted envelope excludes authentication data, races CAS with one winner, and permits inspect inside a READ ONLY transaction.
fence: Read-only creator/grant fence, empty tool arguments, purpose-bound authenticated encryption and revision CAS; fixture tests are not audio E2E.

tests: actual inspect route fences auth, grant, job/site and creator before return, with no host/writes
model preload and empty-argument status tool use server-owned facts; signed-in login tool/action cannot open auth
mounted durable turn saves inflight before inference and final history before response; restart never replays
widget PostgreSQL: real migration, encrypted restart context, owner binding, CAS and SELECT-only build facts
